prompt: Create ONE wide LANDSCAPE 16:9 fine architectural ink-and-watercolour illustration on warm cream art paper. This is a new distinct candidate in the approved Artemis Atlantic Heritage Watercolour series, using the attached image as a STYLE AND BUILDING-FAMILY reference, not a scene to copy. Hand-drawn dark sepia nib, delicate precise cross-hatching, transparent layered watercolor washes, limestone cream/ochre, volcanic basalt grey, restrained bronze, natural greens, quiet Atlantic blue-grey. Airy unfinished vignette edges, sophisticated calm composition, soft natural light. No photorealism or computer 3D, no people, no text, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, amphorae, deeds or money. No exact parcel, approved architectural plan, guaranteed amenity or documentary project-progress claim. One landscape illustration only. One close oblique conceptual material junction: a muted dark photovoltaic glass plane, a restrained bronze edge, warm timber roof beams and cream lime-rendered parapet with a basalt support below. Delicate incomplete architectural ink sketch, partial cutaway purely illustrative, not a certified engineering section or construction progress. No circuit, wiring schematic, dimensions, installers or technical claims.
rights_basis: New concept illustration from approved project style reference; public-use clearance remains pending
